findings.body: This line tells readers to see CONTRIBUTING, but this branch has no CONTRIBUTING (or CONTRIBUTING.md) file — only README.md and poetry.lock. Anyone following the new pointer hits a dead end. Add the contributing guide the sentence refers to, or point at an existing path with a real markdown link (for example `[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)` once that file exists).

summary:
## Verdict

Small docs PR with one real problem in the README, plus an unrelated lockfile downgrade that should not ship with a "link CONTRIBUTING" change.

## README

The only substantive edit adds `See CONTRIBUTING.` under the title. The repository tree at this head contains only `README.md` and `poetry.lock` — there is no `CONTRIBUTING`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or any similarly named file. The new line therefore points readers at a guide that does not exist, and it is plain text rather than a markdown link despite the PR title.

## Lockfile (omitted from inline review)

`poetry.lock` is listed as omitted/generated, so it was not reviewed line-by-line. Its presence in this PR is still material: the lock moves `pyyaml` from `6.0.2` to `5.3.1` with no `pyproject.toml`/manifest change in the diff and no explanation beyond "lock re-resolved." That is a dependency downgrade on a YAML parser with a well-known vulnerability history in the 5.3.x line, bundled under a docs-only title. Confirm the pin is intentional and justified before merge, or drop the lockfile hunk from this PR.

## Release decision

**Recommendation:** request-changes
